disclosuresMarketInformationBody: Ozi ahịa na nkọwa ozi azụmahịa, gụnyere ndekọ ozi tokịn nakwa ozi egosipụtara na-ebe nchọta ozi azụmahịa. A na-emepụta ha site n'iji ozi ahịa nke ebenreahịa ndị nke atọ nke gụnyere ma na-akwụsịghị na ha, CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap, Birdeye, Hyperliquid, StockNewsAPI, CryptoNewsAPI, Finnhub, X API, and Tokens.xyz. E nwekwara ike ịmepụta ozi site n'iji amamihe dijitalụ, nke pụtara na o nwere ike ịnwe ozi ndị n'ezighi ezi. Ozi arụmọrụ egosipụtara bụ nke oge a họọrọ. Nrụpụta nke oge gara aga a naghị egosipụta ihe nrụpụta ga-abụ n'ọdịnihu. Ozi ahịa na nkọwa ozi azụmahịa bụ naanị maka nzikọrịta ozi. Ha abụghị ndụmọdụ ntinye ego ma ọ bụ ntụziaka. Phantom nwere ike i ji ozi gị hazie ihe odide na ozi a na-egosi gị, ya na ma i ji ya hazie ihe omume gị. Ị nwere ike i ji ndabere Iwu Nzowe ozi onwe onye anyị wepụ onwe gị site n'ịmegharị ihe ebe nhazi gị.
disclosuresTokenizedStocksBody: Ahịa Ihe onwunwe nwere ike ịghara ị dị na mpaghara ụfọdụ. Ahịa Ihe onwunwe bụ ngwaahịa ndị mgbado ụkwụ na blọkchenụ ndị nke atọ na-enyefe, emewere ka o soro ngagharị n'ọnụego nakwa nrite ọmụrụnwa. Ngwaahịa ndị a bụ nke nwere nnukwute ihe ize ndụ, nwere ike ha a gaghị eso ọnụahịa tokịn dị ugbua, ma nwekwa ike ịkpata ntufu isi ego. Dịka ha na-agba mbọ ịso ngagharị ọnụahịa nakwa usoro ọrụ nke ihe onwunwe dijitalụ n'ezie, ha a naghị enyefe ikike onwunwe ma ọ bụ uru onye nzụahịa kripto. Ihe onwunwe dijitalụ tupu IPO n'ebu ozize ndụ mgbakwụnye — Ha na-arụzi aka nyere ụlọ-ọrụ ndi n'ebidobeghị ịresị ọha ihe onwunwe, ọnụahịa ka bụ naanị nke a na-eme ntụle. O nwere ike bụrụ n'ụlọ-ọrụ ndị ahụ akpọtụrụ aha enyebeghị ngwaahịa ndị ahụ nkwado, IPO a na-echere nwere ike gbuo oge, e nwere ike a kagbuo ya, ma ọ bụ hapụ ime. Nrụzi aka nyere otu ahịa ihe onwunwe ọbụla bụ naanị maka nzikọrịta ozi, o bụghị ndụmọdụ ntinye ego ahịa ma ọ bụkwanụ ntụziaka. Tupu ị zụkọrịtawa Ahia Ihe onwunwe ma ọ bụ Ihe onwunwe dijitalụ tupu IPO, ndị njiarụ kwesịrị ịnyochagharị Iwu Usoro ọrụ nke onye mmepụta.
disclosuresPredictionMarketsBody: Ahịa Ọkịka ihe nwere ike ọbụrụ na-ọdịghị ugbu a na mpaghara ụfọdụ, akwụmụgwọ nwekwara ike ị so ya. Nzụkọrịta nkwekọrịta azụmahịa ihe omume gbakwụnyere nnukwu ize ndụ ntufu ego, ma nwekwa ike ịbute nfunahụ ego ahịa gị niile. Ị zụkọrịta nkwekọrịta azụmahịa ihe omume nwere ike ọ gaghị a dabara ndị njiarụ niile. Ị gaghị enwe ike ịzụkọrịta nkwekọrịta azụmahịa ihe omume ma ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ozi onye ọbụla nwere akọnauche nwere ike i ji mee mkpebi azụmahịa nke ndị ọha na-enwetabeghị, nke nwekwara ike inye gị aka dị elu n'ịka ihe ndapụta nke ihe omume. Hụ nkwuputa zuru oke: https://phantom.com/prediction-market-disclosures
disclosuresPerpsBody: Nzụkọrịta nkwekọrịta peepụ gụnyere ize ndụ gbara okpụrụkpụ, gụnyere ikike ntufu ego na mberede nakwa ntufu kpam kpam nke ego i tinyerela na-ahịa, ya na ego nnọchianya, n'ihi mgbaziri ihe onwunwe nke dị elu ya na mgbanwe na mberede nke ahịa. Nke a nwere ike ọ gaghị a dabara ndị njiarụ niile. Ọnụego akwụmụgwọ na orire ihe onwunwe nwere ike ị metụta ọnụahịa. E nwere ike ree ihe onwunwe gị n'akpaghị aka nakwa na-amaghị ọkwa. Hyperliquid na-ewepụta ozi ahịa. Ndebiri ihe onwunwe dijitalụ na-arụzi aka na nkwekọrịta peepụ, ọ bụghị ihe onwunwe ụlọọrụ nkeonye ma ọ bụ ihe onwunwe dijitalụ, ọ naghịkwa egosipụta ihe onwunwe nke a na-ahụ anya. Ihe odide ma ọ bụ nrụtụ aka ọbụla nyere ofu nkwekọrịta peepụ, bụ maka naanị nzikọrịta ozi, o bụghị ndụmọdụ ntinye ego ahịa ma ọ bụkwanụ ntụziaka. Na mgbakwunye, nkwekọrịta peepụ nke tupu IPO na-amazi ụlọ-ọrụ ndi n'ebidobeghị ịresị ọha ihe onwunwe; ọnụahịa bụ nke a ka na-eme ntụle, o nwebeghị ọnụego ekpebirila na ya n'oge a, mwepụta ngosipụta ihe onwunwe nke a na-echere nwere ike igbu oge, e nwere ike a kagbuo ya, ma ọ bụ a hazigharịa ya. Nkwekọrịta peepụ dị naanị na mpaghara ndị a họrọ.

disclosuresPsolLiquidStakingBody: Ihe odide a bụ naanị maka nzikọrịta ozi, ọ bụghị ndụmọdụ ntinye ego ma ọ bụ oku ịre ma ọ bụ ịzụta ihe onwunwe dijitalụ. Nrite nkụchi, APY nakwa ọmụrụnwa a na-anaghị anọgide otu ebe, ha bụghị nke a na-ekwere nkwa, ha nwere ike ịgbanwe. I jigide ma ọ bụ ịkụchi ihe onwunwe dijitalụ buu ihe ize ndụ nke gụnyere ihe ndapụta nfunahụ isi ego. Nrụpụta nke oge gara aga a naghị egosipụta ihe nrụpụta ga-abụ n'ọdịnihu.
disclosuresCashBody:
Phantom Cash na-enye ikike mkpakọrịta na-etiti stablecoins na ndị nke atọ site na-ihu ebe ihe omume Phantom. A na-emepụta ngwaahịa Phantom Cash site na mmekọrịta ndị nreahịa ego onye nke atọ, ikike iji mee ihe gị nọ n'okpuru iwu na usoro ọrụ ha ya nakwa Iwu Usoro I ji mee ihe Phantom. I ji were Phantom Cash mee ihe, a chọrọ ka ị mezuo nyocha njirimara (KYC) nke ndị otu ọrụ anyị ndị nke atọ ga-anakọta ma chekwaa. Phantom a naghị edekwa KYC gị. E nwere ike i kekọrịta ozi onwe onye gị nye ndị otu ọrụ ndị nke atọ i ji mee ka Cash na-arụ ọrụ, gbochie mpụ, ma rube isi nye iwu ọrụ dịka e siri kọwa ya na Iwu Nzowe ozi onwe onye. 

Oge ị jiri Phantom Cash mee ihe na-akụrụngwa ọhụrụ, a ga-agwa gị ka ị mezuo nyocha ọzọ maka nchekwa usoro akwụmụgwọ ndị ọzọ na akaụntụ ụlọakụ e jikọrọ ya na ha. Ihe omume dijitalụ ị na akpaego ndowere onwe gị, tinyere stablecoins, dị n'okpuru nchekwa gị oge niile. Phantom e nweghị ikike mbanye na akpaego gị ma ọ bụ ihe onwunwe ndị dị ya n'ime. Ha a gaghị enwe ike ịmegharị, kagbuo ma ọ bụ hazigharịa nweta na nzipu ego nke chenụ. Ọ bụrụ na okwu nwetaghachi gị efuo ma ọ bụ na-ezuru ya, ego gị nwere ike ifunahụ anya. 

Phantom Cash nwere ike ọ dịghị na-ụfọdụ mpaghara. Phantom abụghị ụlọakụ. Kaadị Mwere ego Visa ahụ bụ Lead Bank n'enye ya, Bridge Ventures, LLC na-ejikwa ya. Akwụmụgwọ nwere ike iso ya. Lelee webụsaịtị Phantom maka nkọwa ndị ọzọ.

tcgFaqQuestionWhatIsACardPack: Nke a ọ bụ kaadị a na-ahụ anya?
tcgFaqAnswerWhatIsACardPack: E. Kaadị ọbụla bụ nke a na-ahụ anya, ndị ọkachamara nyere akara ule e dowekwara na-ebe nchekwa ihe onwunwe. Ihe ị na-azụ bụ tokịn 1:1 dị n'ime ebe nzụkọrịta ahịa, na-anọchite anya kaadị ahụ kpọmkwem.
tcgFaqQuestionHowDoOddsWork: Kaadị ọ bụ ezi ụzọ isi tinye ego n'ahịa?
tcgFaqAnswerHowDoOddsWork: Ọnụego kaadị nwere ike isoro ọchịchọ, ụkọ nakwa ọnọdụ rịa ma ọ bụ daa. Zụkọrịta naanị maka na ọ na-amasị gị — E mefukwala karịa ego ị nwere ike ịtufu.
tcgFaqQuestionWhatCanIDoWithCards: Ọtụtụ mmadụ o nwere ike ịnwe otu kaadị?
tcgFaqAnswerWhatCanIDoWithCards: Mba. Kaadị ọbụla dị iche, ma bụrụkwa ngwa e nyere akara ule nke otu tokịn kwụdebere, ka otu akpaego nwe ike ịnwe ya n'otu oge.
tcgFaqQuestionCanIGetPhysicalCopy: Kedu ka m ga-esi nweta kaadị m?
tcgFaqAnswerCanIGetPhysicalCopy: Ị nwere ike i zigara onwe gị kaadị ọbụla ịnwe dịka kaadị a na-ahụ anya, e nyerela akara ule. Mepee Collector Crypt i ji bido nziga.
